newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends nearly flat after opening lower.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends nearly flat after opening lower.

text.p: The won closed nearly unchanged against the dollar on Monday as exporter deals offset the dollar's demand stemming from its strength against the yen in global markets, dealers said.
The dollar's rise versus the yen helped the won open at a daily low of 893.20. The won ended at a high of 892.50 against Friday's close of 892.40.
Dealers said trading would remain quiet until the planned expansion of the foreign stock ownership limit on May 2.
